anchorAudit.rationale: The pathology raster visibly resolves microscopes and optical parts, specimen handling benches, paraffin embedding and microtomy tools, staining equipment and a tall cold-storage cabinet; clinical display terms remain generic and educational.

visualRegions.description: Complete bright pathology laboratory with microscopes, specimen processing, embedding, staining and cold storage
Two research microscopes and slide handling tools across the left glass laboratory bench
Specimen jars, tissue cassettes, trays and pipettes arranged across the central processing bench
Paraffin embedding station with molds, microtome, wax blocks and trimming tools at the right
Staining tray, reagent bottles, pipette rack and centrifuge at the front-right bench
Tall cold-storage cabinet and specimen refrigerator along the far-right wall
Abstract clinical display panels and monitor surfaces above the laboratory work areas
